resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (live fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) ConnectTimeouts -- geo-blocked host per scope guidance, not dead. Wayback snapshot of the same notice (2025-04-13, HTTP 200; url_verifier OK against the plan-title tokens '广西能源基础设施建设'/'工作推进方案') is Guangxi DRC notice 桂发改电力〔2023〕205号 (drafted 2023-03-25, issued 2023-04-03), linking Attachment 5 ('全区2023年能源项目投资计划表（油气及煤炭储运）'), also Wayback-archived and 200. url_verifier FAILs the xlsx URL on the '大任' substring check -- documented false negative for binary/compressed files (per the verifier's own docstring); I downloaded the snapshot and opened it directly with openpyxl (independent of the prior row-audit's own manual check) and confirmed row 29 (序号21): 项目名称 '大任—南丹天然气支线项目'. As of this document's issue date (2023-04) the row shows 项目代码 (project code) = '未取得' (not yet obtained) and 2023年建设任务 = '施工入场，开展项目征地' (site entry / land acquisition only, construction not yet begun) -- fully consistent with a 'proposed' (not yet under construction) status. Single-origin government source (notice + its own attachment) so tier=medium, independent=false; no second, genuinely independent outlet with this level of project detail was located (WebSearch budget for this session was already exhausted before I could run further queries). NOTE (out of ref-sweep scope, flagged for status-review workflow, not acted on here): row-audit shard rows/P7689.json already flags this same evidence as stale (>2y since last confirmed progress) and presumes shelved -- that is a status *change* recommendation, separate from confirming the recorded value has a working ref, which is this unit's job.

Same Wayback-archived DRC investment-plan attachment (project name '大任—南丹天然气支线项目' = Daren-Nandan GAS branch-line project; 类别 (category) column = '油气及煤炭储运' i.e. oil/gas & coal storage-transport) directly supports Fuel=Gas. Manually confirmed via openpyxl after url_verifier's documented binary-file false negative on the xlsx substring check (see Status [ref] notes for detail). Single origin, tier=medium, independent=false.

Same DRC attachment row 29, '建设规模和内容' (scope of construction) field reads '新建输气管道约97公里，3座站场和3座阀室...' -- '新建输气管道' = newly-built gas TRANSMISSION pipeline (输气管道, distinct from a local distribution 配气管道), 3 stations + 3 valve chambers -- directly supports PipelineType=transmission and rules out a gathering/distribution classification. Manually confirmed via openpyxl (url_verifier binary false-negative on the xlsx, as noted on Status [ref]). Single origin, tier=medium, independent=false.

Recorded ProposalMonth=12 (Dec 2023) disagrees with what the primary source actually shows. In the same DRC investment-plan attachment row 29, the '开工年月' (planned CONSTRUCTION-START month) column = 2023-12-01 -- a different field entirely from a proposal/announcement date. The document that actually lists/proposes the project was drafted 2023-03-25 and issued 2023-04-03 (confirmed by fetching the Wayback notice page directly: '成文日期： 2023年03月25日 ... 桂发改电力〔2023〕205号 发布日期： 2023年04月03日'). No source found supports December as the proposal month; the pattern strongly suggests the construction-start-month cell was miscopied into ProposalMonth. Per standing rule 2/task instructions, not proposing a ref for a value the evidence contradicts -- this needs a value correction (ProposalMonth -> 03 or 04, or move Dec-2023 to a construction-start field if the schema has one), which is an Update-workflow action, not a ref-sweep fill. (Row-audit shard rows/P7689.json flags the identical discrepancy independently as a 'concern' item -- corroborating this is a real defect, not a search miss.)

Same attachment row 29 scope field: '...设计压力4.0兆帕，管径DN300' -- '设计压力4.0兆帕' = design pressure 4.0 MPa, exact match to recorded Pressure=4.00 MPa. Manually confirmed via openpyxl (url_verifier binary false-negative on the xlsx, as noted on Status [ref]). Single origin, tier=medium, independent=false.

StartLocation=Daren / EndLocation=Nandan / province=Guangxi / country=China are all confirmed by the same DRC attachment (project name '大任—南丹天然气支线项目'). But the recorded StartPrefecture/District and EndPrefecture/District ('Laibin') DISAGREE with the primary source: the same row 29 lists '主要责任单位' (main responsible unit) = '河池市发展改革委' (Hechi Municipal DRC) and '项目管理层级' (jurisdiction/management level) = '河池市' (Hechi City) -- both independently re-confirmed here via openpyxl, not just taken from the prior row-audit. A second, differently-derived source (163.com news article, https://www.163.com/dy/article/I1LS14H30552R5WK.html, verified 200 + content present, published 2023-04-06) independently groups this exact project under Hechi City's project slate: '河池市共建设24个能源项目...还建设了金城江电站工程、大任—南丹天然气支线项目等项目' -- Nandan County is a Hechi-city county, not Laibin's. Since the compound Location value includes a component (prefecture) the evidence contradicts, not proposing a ref for the cell as currently recorded -- per standing rule 2, this is a value-correction candidate (StartPrefecture/District & EndPrefecture/District: Laibin -> Hechi) for the Update workflow, not a ref-sweep fill. (Row-audit shard rows/P7689.json flags this identical defect independently as an 'attribution' concern.)
